theory.title: CI/CD Concepts
theory.content:
Continuous Integration

Automatically build and test every commit

Continuous Delivery

Every passing build is ready to deploy (manual release)

Continuous Deployment

Every passing build auto-deploys to production

theory.title: GitHub Actions
theory.content:
Workflow

YAML file in .github/workflows/ triggered by events

Jobs and Steps

Jobs run parallel by default. Steps run sequential within a job

Secrets

Use ${{ secrets.NAME }} for sensitive data

theory.title: Deployment Strategies
theory.content:
Blue-Green

Two identical environments, instant switch

Canary

Gradually shift traffic to new version

Rolling

Replace instances one by one for zero downtime

theory.title: Docker in CI/CD
theory.content:
Containerization

Package app and dependencies into immutable image

Multi-stage Builds

Build in large image, copy to minimal runtime

Registry

Store and version images (ECR, GCR, Docker Hub)

theory.title: Observability
theory.content:
Metrics

Numerical measurements over time (latency, error rate)

Logs

Timestamped event records for debugging

Traces

Track requests across services
